This policy explains what information Integrity Roofing collects through integrityroofingaz.com, how we use it, and the choices you have.

What we collect

When you request an estimate or send us a message, we collect what you enter in the form: your name, phone number, email address, city, property and roof type, and your message. We don't ask for payment information on this website.

Like most websites, our hosting provider automatically records basic technical information, such as your browser type and the pages you visit, to keep the site secure and working.

How we use it

  • To contact you about your request and schedule your estimate
  • To provide the roofing services you ask for
  • To keep records of the work we do

We don't sell or rent your information, and we don't use it for anything unrelated to your request.

Who we share it with

Form submissions are delivered to our office email through a form-delivery service (Web3Forms). Our website is hosted by Vercel. These providers handle the information only to deliver the service to us. We may also share information if the law requires it.

Maps and videos

Some pages include a Google Map or a Facebook video. When those load, Google or Facebook may collect information under their own privacy policies.

How long we keep it

We keep estimate requests and customer records for as long as we need them to serve you and to meet our business and legal obligations.

Your choices

You can ask us to see, correct or delete the information you've given us. Call 602-548-3770 (Monday to Friday, 7 am to 5 pm) or email office.integrityroofing@gmail.com.

Children

This website isn't directed to children under 13, and we don't knowingly collect their information.

Changes to this policy

If we change this policy, we'll update this page. Last updated October 28, 2026.
